preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100.
The number of vertices N must be even and between 2 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All vertices in the edges must be within the range from 1 to N.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the minimum value of k, followed by the vertices in sets U and V.
The sets U and V must each contain exactly N/2 vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(u in U and v in V for u, v in E)
postconditions.description: All edges in E must connect vertices from U to V.
